relationship_description: Arthur Yap, former Bohol governor and congressman, is the brother of Henry Yap, a Bohol board member
Arthur Yap is the son of Virgilio Yap, a businessman and political figure in Bohol
Arthur Yap served as Secretary of Agriculture and Cabinet Secretary under President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, indicating a strong political alliance between the Yap and Macapagal-Arroyo dynasties
